The District Council of Franklin Harbour meets at 1.00pm on the second Wednesday of each month. The meetings are open to the public to observe.
 
Minutes and Current Council Notice of Meeting and Agenda
Council minutes are a record of what has been decided at Council meetings. Copies of minutes are available for public viewing at the Council office. Copies can also be emailed to you on a monthly basis. Minutes of previous Council meetings can also be viewed by selecting from the listing below. Council Agendas can be viewed after the Council meeting, please contact Council office for further information.
Deputations
Members of the community may put their views on particular issues to Council via a number of means, one of which is a deputation/presentation to Council. If you would like further information contact the Council Office.

Cowell is situated on Franklin Harbour approximately halfway between Port Augusta and Port Lincoln, it is an ideal place for visitors to break a long journey or to take a holiday and enjoy the pleasant climate and relaxed life style. One of the safest and best fishing areas in South Australia, Franklin Harbour is a land-locked bay with a narrow entrance through which boats have access to the harbour's calm waters.

The District Council of Franklin Harbour meets at 1.00pm on the second Wednesday of each month. The meetings are open to the public to observe.
 
Minutes and Current Council Notice of Meeting and Agenda
Council minutes are a record of what has been decided at Council meetings. Copies of minutes are available for public viewing at the Council office. Copies can also be emailed to you on a monthly basis. Minutes of previous Council meetings can also be viewed by selecting from the listing below. Council Agendas can be viewed after the Council meeting, please contact Council office for further information.
Deputations
Members of the community may put their views on particular issues to Council via a number of means, one of which is a deputation/presentation to Council. If you would like further information contact the Council Office.

Cowell is situated on Franklin Harbour approximately halfway between Port Augusta and Port Lincoln, it is an ideal place for visitors to break a long journey or to take a holiday and enjoy the pleasant climate and relaxed life style. One of the safest and best fishing areas in South Australia, Franklin Harbour is a land-locked bay with a narrow entrance through which boats have access to the harbour's calm waters.
